integrity: Theorem proved in accompanying result using an independent Gaussian innovation representation, exact beta law, and moderate deviations; programmatic tests corroborate finite identities but are not a substitute for asymptotic proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact unit-block Gaussian relative-Frobenius QB on flat identity spectra, fixed tolerance, real arithmetic; not a general guarantee for other block sizes, spectra, or floating-point QR. Bibliographic coverage of the inaccessible motivating manuscript remains uncertain.
title: Sharp sequential early-stopping bias for Gaussian QB on flat spectra
